method: Independent direct human inspection of the source photo. No expected inventory, model output, or other census consulted.

result.whyRange: Eight board dice and one loose die have individually discernible boundaries. Two touching/partly overlapping white objects on the player board have ambiguous cube boundaries; they may be one or two additional dice. The count range includes that ambiguity and does not infer dice outside the image.

countingRule: Count each physical cube once regardless of visible top and side faces. Dice on the central player board and loose dice above it are both included. Components inside storage trays are not counted as dice unless a die-shaped cube is visually distinguishable.
